en: Convoy raid

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: a Combine convoy of 3 or 4 merchants and replenishment ships is due through this water under a five-ship destroyer escort, and a patrol submarine waits along its route. Mission: sink or disable 60% of its tonnage. Execution: close unseen, strike the merchants and break off before the escort can pin you. Keep the hull sonar listening. A raided lane stays cut for 10 days and patrols thin across the region.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Depot strike

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the depot hulk moored here holds fuel and shells for the region's groups. A harbour garrison guards her and a destroyer group lies close by. Mission: destroy the depot. Execution: come in from seaward, fire on the hulk and withdraw. An empty depot cuts every lane it feeds for 10 days.

en: Radar decapitation

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: this radar site fills the Combine's picture of the region. A garrison and an air-defence group cover it. Mission: destroy the site. Execution: approach under emission control, then engage it with guns, or land a party by boat. Get clear before the group can close.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Agent extraction

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: 4 of our people are waiting at the landing on this island. A patrol covers the shore and a destroyer group is within reach. Mission: bring all 4 aboard alive. Execution: hold within 100 m of the landing under 3 kn for 60 s while the boat goes in, then leave by the exit. A destroyer needs a boat davit fitted first.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Minelaying

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: this lane carries the Combine's traffic between its yards and bases. A heavy patrol works it, a patrol submarine guards it and a missile group is nearby. Mission: lay 8 mines across the lane. Execution: fit mine rails, draw the line on the plot table and hold its course at 6 kn or more. A laid field cuts the lane.

en: Prize capture

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: 1 or 2 merchants are passing under a destroyer escort. Mission: stop one and take her. Execution: fit a boarding kit, disable her propulsion, come within 200 m under 5 kn and hold for 90 s while the boarding team works. Either ship taking fire aborts the capture. A prize brought home pays more than a wreck.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Defector escort

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: a motor yacht carrying 6 Combine staff who have walked out is making for the rendezvous. She is neutral until she reaches it. A destroyer group is in pursuit. Mission: bring the yacht to the exit. Execution: meet her, take off her people or screen her, and lose the pursuit. We can afford to lose 1 of them.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Feint

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: a raid elsewhere needs this region's destroyer group looking the wrong way. Mission: be seen, hold its attention for 5 minutes, then escape. Execution: let them detect you, keep the range open with decoys and drones, and run before they close. A submarine may come up behind them.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Photo reconnaissance

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the Combine is fitting out new ships on this shore. A garrison lies off them with a patrol submarine, and an air-defence group patrols nearby. Mission: photograph 3 of the ships. Execution: fit a camera mast, then hold each target in its 10° field of view, within 6 km and in sight, for 20 s. Stay unseen.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Hunter group

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: a hunter group of Consol destroyers has found SEXTANT's cove, and submarines are waiting off the exit. This operation cannot be declined. Mission: survive 15 minutes and leave by the exit. Execution: use emission control, decoys and drones to break contact; fight only to clear the way out.

en: Cutting out

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: a merchant lies at her berth in this harbour under a garrison, with a destroyer group outside. Mission: take her and sail her out. Execution: fit a boarding kit, slip in under 5 m of draft, board her at the berth and bring her to the exit under her own Helm officer.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: The Orrin depot

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the fuel and shells for every group in the Roads lie at Orrin, the north depot behind the Meridian chokepoint. A garrison guards the hulks and a destroyer group lies close by. Mission: destroy the depot. Execution: come in from seaward, fire on the hulks and withdraw. With Orrin empty the north of the Roads runs dry.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: Halden Rock

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the listening station on Halden Rock hears every emitter in the Roads and passes it to the Chairman's flagship. A garrison and an air-defence group cover it, with a submarine off the rock. Mission: destroy the station. Execution: come in under emission control and strike it with guns, or land a party by boat. The Chairman is expected to come out.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: The Castor slip

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the cruiser squadron lies at Port Castor between patrols, under an air-defence group, at the berths the Charter uses. Mission: photograph the cruiser and her destroyer at their moorings. Execution: fit a camera mast, slip in under 5 m of draft and hold each ship in the camera's 10° field of view, within 6 km and in sight, for 20 s. With these we will know when the Charter sails.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: Sentinel Reach

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the fleet train that fuels and arms the Charter is crossing Sentinel Reach from Quay Nine under a five-ship destroyer escort, with a patrol submarine ahead. Mission: sink or disable 75% of its tonnage. Execution: strike the replenishment ships and break off. Without them the flagship cannot stay at sea.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: Vote of no confidence

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the Chairman's flagship, Charter, is at sea with an air-defence group. Her 155 mm turrets reach 18 km and she keeps 17 km, behind an 80 mm belt and 32 surface-to-air missiles. Mission: sink or disable the Charter. Execution: two missiles at a time will not get through; set rules that fire every missile at once from range, and dodge her salvoes. Taken intact she is worth more.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: The Meridian yards

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the Meridian yards build every ship the Combine sails, and their depot fuels the Roads. A heavy task group and the cruiser squadron lie off the slipways with a garrison and a submarine, strike aircraft are 5 minutes out and a missile group 10. Mission: destroy the depot. Execution: strike fast and get clear before the second wave arrives. This breaks the Combine's hold on the Saltreach.
